sources.snippet: ReelBids — LTX-2.5 dolly-in camera LoRA A single rank-32 LoRA that drives a dolly-in camera move at seven selectable speeds, for LTX-2.5 22B image-to-video. Speed is chosen by a trigger token in the prompt, so one adapter covers the whole range — unlike the official LTX-2 19b camera LoRAs, which are single-speed and 19b-only.
